propositions: The box fixture captures and returns os.environ directly, causing ambient credentials to be rendered in pytest failure output when tests fail
Synthetic sentinel secrets in the ambient environment appear in pytest-rendered fixture arguments during test failure reporting
The fixture must be refactored to pass only required environment variables or use a representation-safe wrapper while preserving subprocess environment for test behavior
Sibling subprocess fixtures with the same dict(os.environ)-inside-rendered-fixture pattern must be audited and fixed or tracked as follow-ups
After the fix, synthetic sentinel secrets must not appear in pytest failure output and the autodeploy test suite must remain functionally passing
